sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是蕾切尔·亚伯拉姆斯。

sentences.en: Today, Elon Musk and his team have taken a hacksaw to the federal bureaucracy one agency at a time.
sentences.zh: 今天，埃隆·马斯克和他的团队对联邦官僚机构挥起了锯子，一个机构接一个机构地整顿。

sentences.en: And the question has become whether he's on a crusade that will leave the government paralyzed or deliver exactly the kind of shakeup it's needed for years.
sentences.zh: 而问题变成了，他是在进行一场会让政府陷入瘫痪的十字军东征，还是会带来政府多年来一直需要的彻底震撼。

sentences.en: My colleague, Jonathan Swan, takes us inside this hostile takeover of Washington.
sentences.zh: 我的同事乔纳森·斯旺将带我们深入了解这场对华盛顿的敌意收购。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月5日，星期三。

sentences.en: So, Jonathan, we always understood that Elon Musk was going to be important in this administration in the second Trump presidency.
sentences.zh: 所以，乔纳森，我们一直都知道埃隆·马斯克在特朗普的第二任期内将在这届政府中占据重要地位。

sentences.en: Trump had given the group that Musk was put in charge of, the Department of Government
sentences.zh: 特朗普把马斯克负责的那个组织，也就是政府部门

sentences.en: Efficiency, or DOGE as it's commonly known, the job of shrinking the entire federal government.
sentences.zh: 效率部，也就是通常所说的DOGE，赋予了精简整个联邦政府的工作。

sentences.en: But the question was always just how much power Musk would actually have as a private citizen operating outside the president's cabinet.
sentences.zh: 但问题一直是，作为一名在总统内阁之外运作的普通公民，马斯克到底会拥有多大的权力。

sentences.en: And over the past few days, we've actually started to get an answer, which is a whole lot of power.
sentences.zh: 而在过去几天里，我们实际上开始得到答案，那就是极大的权力。

sentences.en: Yes, his power is extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 是的，他的权力非同寻常。

sentences.en: He effectively is unaccountable.
sentences.zh: 他实际上是不受约束的。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has fully empowered him to roam across the federal government, get inside the pipes of the federal government, look at the payment systems and the databases to embed
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普已全权授权他在联邦政府内部四处视察，深入联邦政府的内部运作，查看支付系统和数据库，以嵌入

sentences.en: inside these agencies.
sentences.zh: 这些机构内部。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this is not some chin-stroking professor doing an analysis of government from the outside and, you know, let me sit down at my table and write you some recommendations.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝不是某个摸着下巴从外部对政府进行分析的教授，你知道的，让我坐在桌前给你写一些建议。

sentences.en: You know, Walter Isaacson wrote a biography about Elon Musk where people who know him talk
sentences.zh: 你知道，沃尔特·艾萨克森写过一本关于埃隆·马斯克的传记，里面认识他的人谈到了

sentences.en: about quote-unquote demon mode, which he goes into, which is this sort of manic energy, staying up all night, sleeping on the floor of the factory.
sentences.zh: 所谓的“恶魔模式”，他会进入这种状态，这是一种狂热的精力，整夜不睡，睡在工厂的地板上。

sentences.en: He's done this at Tesla, SpaceX, Twitter, setting unrealistic deadlines, doing mass layoffs because he thinks staff aren't hardcore enough.
sentences.zh: 他在特斯拉、SpaceX、推特都这样做过，设定不切实际的截止日期，进行大规模裁员，因为他认为员工还不够硬核。

sentences.en: He's effectively trying to do that to the federal government.
sentences.zh: 他实际上正试图对联邦政府也这样做。

sentences.en: His team have moved beds into agency offices.
sentences.zh: 他的团队已经把床搬进了机构办公室。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么做到的？

sentences.en: He has an office space in the West Wing.
sentences.zh: 他在西翼有一间办公室。

sentences.en: And he also has been working out of this opulent Secretary of War suite in the Eisenhower Executive
sentences.zh: 而且他一直在艾森豪威尔行政

sentences.en: Office Building.
sentences.zh: 办公大楼里那间富丽堂皇的战争部长套房里办公。

sentences.en: And he's brought with him this cohort from Silicon Valley, people who've worked for him at Tesla
sentences.zh: 他带来了这群来自硅谷的人，也就是那些曾在特斯拉

sentences.en: and SpaceX, and he's installed them in some of the most important parts of government.
sentences.zh: 和SpaceX为他工作过的人，并将他们安插在政府最核心的部门中。

sentences.en: So this is Elon Musk getting his hands into government, doing what he's done at these companies.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是埃隆·马斯克将手伸进政府，做他在这些公司里做过的事。

sentences.en: And remember, we should say, you know, he's been in the private sector, probably the singular entrepreneur of our lifetime.
sentences.zh: 而且记住，我们应该说，你知道，他一直身处私营部门，可能是我们时代绝无仅有的企业家。

sentences.en: But if you understand what he's done with his business, he is marked by incredible risk
sentences.zh: 但如果你了解他用自己的企业所做的事情，他的特点就是令人难以置信的风险

sentences.en: taking, extreme risk taking, and a willingness to, if he or his employees consider regulations
sentences.zh: 承担，极端的风险承担，并且如果他和他的员工认为规章

sentences.en: or laws to be, quote unquote, dumb, he pushes them, and particularly at SpaceX, to defy those regulations, just do it anyway.
sentences.zh: 或法律是所谓的“愚蠢”的，他就会敦促他们，特别是在SpaceX，去无视这些规章，无论如何都要去做。

sentences.en: And if people want to sue, so be it.
sentences.zh: 如果人们想要起诉，那就随他们去吧。

sentences.en: If it gets to the mission of what he's trying to accomplish, we're seeing that kind of approach inside government right now.
sentences.zh: 如果这符合他试图实现的使命，我们现在在政府内部也看到了这种做法。

sentences.en: Okay, so what is that demon mode risk taking ethos actually look like that he's applying to the government?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么他应用到政府身上的那种“恶魔模式”的冒险精神到底是什么样的？

sentences.en: What has he been up to this past week?
sentences.zh: 他过去这一周都在忙些什么？

sentences.en: Well, the first sign of Musk and his team moving into government, the first physical sign was literally right after Trump's inauguration, the day after.
sentences.zh: 嗯，马斯克和他的团队进驻政府的第一个迹象，第一个实质性迹象，字面意思上就在特朗普就职后紧接着的第二天。

sentences.en: Workers in the Eisenhower Executive Office Building, which is the big building next to the
sentences.zh: 艾森豪威尔行政办公大楼（也就是紧邻

sentences.en: West Wing, they show up to work.
sentences.zh: 西翼的大楼）里的工作人员，他们来上班了。

sentences.en: And this building houses some operations for the United States Digital Service.
sentences.zh: 这座大楼里容纳了美国数字服务的一些运作机构。

sentences.en: This is to an operation that was set up in 2014 to fix the federal government's online services.
sentences.zh: 这是一个成立于2014年以修复联邦政府在线服务的机构。

sentences.en: And they find a sticky note saying DOGE, D-O-G-E, on a door to a suite that was once used as a workspace.
sentences.zh: 他们在一间曾被用作工作空间的套房门上发现了一张写着DOGE（D-O-G-E）的便条。

sentences.en: A literal post-it note.
sentences.zh: 一张字面意义上的便利贴。

sentences.en: Yeah, literally a sticky note on the door saying DOGE.
sentences.zh: 是的，门上真的贴着一张写有DOGE的便条。

sentences.en: And this used to be a workspace for senior technologists at the agency.
sentences.zh: 这里过去是该机构高级技术专家的工作空间。

sentences.en: And inside, there were these black backpacks that were strewed about.
sentences.zh: 里面散落着一些黑色的背包。

sentences.en: You had these young engineers, many of them in their 20s.
sentences.zh: 你会看到这些年轻的工程师，许多人只有二十多岁。

sentences.en: Some of them were wearing t-shirts with blazers over them, roaming the halls, unfamiliar faces,
sentences.zh: 他们有的人穿着T恤外面套着西装外套，在走廊里游荡，面孔陌生，

sentences.en: didn't have security badges on that federal employees typically take when they go into offices.
sentences.zh: 没有佩戴联邦雇员进入办公室时通常会戴的安全徽章。

sentences.en: And it turned out that this was the Musk army, the cohort of young men who work for Musk or who are in his network.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这是马斯克的军队，也就是为马斯克工作或在他的人脉网络中的那群年轻人。

sentences.en: And they have come to Washington to help Musk on his mission of slashing the federal government.
sentences.zh: 他们来到华盛顿，是为了协助马斯克完成削减联邦政府的使命。

sentences.en: And the message is really clear.
sentences.zh: 而传达的信息非常明确。

sentences.en: They have arrived.
sentences.zh: 他们已经到了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And they're not wasting any time.
sentences.zh: 而且他们一刻也没有浪费。

sentences.en: My colleagues and I have talked to federal employees at different agencies, and it's really quite extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事们与不同机构的联邦雇员交谈过，情况确实相当惊人。

sentences.en: I mean, these Musk allies are interviewing people across agencies, asking them, what have you done lately?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些马斯克的盟友正在各个机构面试人员，问他们，你最近做了什么？

sentences.en: Give me examples of work you've done.
sentences.zh: 给我举几个你做过的工作的例子。

sentences.en: Justify your job.
sentences.zh: 证明你这份工作存在的合理性。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And when the federal employees ask them, well, who are you?
sentences.zh: 当联邦雇员问他们，好吧，你们是谁？

sentences.en: In some cases, they're refusing to give their names because they don't want to be doxed, or they'll just give their first name.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们拒绝透露自己的名字，因为他们不想被公开个人信息，或者他们只报自己的名字。

sentences.en: So there's this sort of atmosphere of we're putting the fear of God into all of you.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有一种“我们要让你们所有人感到敬畏”的氛围。

sentences.en: And there is a real hostility that they're showing to the federal workforce.
sentences.zh: 他们对联邦劳动力表现出了真正的敌意。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They're really trying to send the message that we've arrived, this conversation goes one way, we ask the questions.
sentences.zh: 他们真的很想传达这样一个信息：我们已经到了，这场对话只有一种走向，我们来问问题。

sentences.en: What's the next big thing that happens last week?
sentences.zh: 上周发生的大事件是什么？

sentences.en: Well, there's been so much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，发生了太多事了。

sentences.en: But one of the big signs of Musk's imprint was an email that went out to roughly two million federal workers, which is really kind of in itself extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 但马斯克留下印记的重大迹象之一，是一封发给大约两百万联邦工人的电子邮件，这本身就相当惊人。

sentences.en: You know, this is not something that normally happens.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这通常是不会发生的。

sentences.en: And they sent out this email offering them the option to resign, but be paid through the end of September.
sentences.zh: 他们发出了这封电子邮件，为他们提供了一个选择：辞职，但薪水可以领到9月底。

sentences.en: And the email subject line, fork in the road, was the same one that Musk used in the email he sent to Twitter employees when he offered them severance packages in late 2022.
sentences.zh: 这封邮件的主题是“岔路口”，这与马斯克在2022年底向推特员工提供遣散费时发送的电子邮件主题完全一样。

sentences.en: And it says, basically, we'd love you to resign, quit your lower productivity public sector job and take a higher productivity private sector job.
sentences.zh: 基本上是说，我们希望你辞职，辞掉你那个生产力较低的公共部门工作，去从事生产力更高的私营部门工作。

sentences.en: So it literally devalued their jobs.
sentences.zh: 所以这实际上贬低了他们的工作。

sentences.en: So he's basically encouraging people to leave the government entirely and do something, quote,
sentences.zh: 因此，他基本上是在鼓励人们完全离开政府，去做一些在私营部门中所谓的

sentences.en: unquote, more productive in the private sector, which I can imagine if you're a civil servant, that feels like you're being treated with contempt.
sentences.zh: “更有成效”的事情，我可以想象，如果你是一个公务员，这会让你觉得受了轻蔑。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And then Musk goes further and starts targeting other departments.
sentences.zh: 然后马斯克更进一步，开始将目标对准其他部门。

sentences.en: So where does he start?
sentences.zh: 那么他从哪里开始呢？

sentences.en: Musk began as a matter of priority with the Treasury Department.
sentences.zh: 马斯克把财政部当作重中之重。

sentences.en: His team, and this goes back to December during the transition, but they became fixated on the
sentences.zh: 他的团队（这可以追溯到12月份过渡期的时候），开始痴迷于

sentences.en: payment system for the entire federal government that literally distributes more than $5 trillion a year in federal spending.
sentences.zh: 整个联邦政府的支付系统，该系统实际上分发着超过5万亿美元的联邦支出。

sentences.en: So just imagine millions of Americans' social security details and personal details, a very, very closely guarded system, usually monitored by career civil servants who are
sentences.zh: 所以试想一下，数百万美国人的社保详情和个人信息，一个受到极其严密保护的系统，通常由经验丰富

sentences.en: very experienced.
sentences.zh: 的职业公务员进行监控。

sentences.en: And this came to a head last week when a top career official at Treasury resisted giving Musk's representatives access to the federal payment system.
sentences.zh: 上周，当财政部的一名高级职业官员拒绝让马斯克的代表接触联邦支付系统时，事情达到了白热化。

sentences.en: He just said no.
sentences.zh: 他直接拒绝了。

sentences.en: He just said no.
sentences.zh: 他直接说不。

sentences.en: This is not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这绝不可能发生。

sentences.en: I don't agree with this.
sentences.zh: 我不同意这样做。

sentences.en: And he was threatened with administrative leave and then retired.
sentences.zh: 他受到了行政休假的威胁，随后便退休了。

sentences.en: So all this happens on Friday.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都发生在周五。

sentences.en: And then the Treasury
sentences.zh: 然后财政部

sentences.en: Secretary, Scott Besant, approved access for the Musk team to the payment system.
sentences.zh: 长斯科特·贝森特批准马斯克团队访问该支付系统。

sentences.en: OK, so let me see if I understand this.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我看看我有没有理解错。

sentences.en: Musk sends his guys in there.
sentences.zh: 马斯克派他的人去那里。

sentences.en: They demand access to this very sensitive system.
sentences.zh: 他们要求访问这个高度机密的系统。

sentences.en: It runs all the payments for the federal government.
sentences.zh: 它运行着联邦政府所有的支付业务。

sentences.en: Somebody tries to resist and that guy basically, quote unquote, retires, meaning maybe gets fired and then they get in the pipes anyway.
sentences.zh: 有人试图反抗，然后那个人基本上“被退休”了，意思可能是被解雇了，然后他们无论如何都闯了进去。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And when we talk to former senior Treasury officials, they can't remember of an instance ever when this has happened.
sentences.zh: 当我们与财政部前高级官员交谈时，他们记不起以前有过这样的先例。

sentences.en: And there are understandable concerns that an intrusion into the system by outsiders such as Musk's team could lead to critical government obligations going unpaid
sentences.zh: 人们有充分的担忧，即马斯克团队等局外人对该系统的侵入，可能导致关键的政府义务无法兑现，

sentences.en: from missed benefit payments to even more dramatic consequences.
sentences.zh: 从错过的福利金发放，到更具戏剧性的后果。

sentences.en: Now, very important to note, the White House has said on the record now, it took a while for us to get
sentences.zh: 现在非常重要的一点是，白宫现已在公开记录中表示（我们花了一些时间才弄清楚这一点）：

sentences.en: clarity on this, that the access they were granted was, quote unquote, read only.
sentences.zh: 他们被授予的权限是所谓的“只读”。

sentences.en: At least that's what it is now, meaning the Musk allies who are now Treasury officials can read and monitor these payments but can't alter them.
sentences.zh: 至少现在是这样，这意味着现任财政部官员的马斯克盟友可以阅读和监控这些支付，但不能更改它们。

sentences.en: Why do we think Musk wants access to the actual system?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们认为马斯克想要访问实际系统？

sentences.en: Like, why does he even want his people in their reading?
sentences.zh: 比如，为什么他甚至想让他的手下进去阅读？

sentences.en: There's two parts to this.
sentences.zh: 这包含两个部分。

sentences.en: So we've talked to a lot of people who Musk has talked to privately within the administration.
sentences.zh: 我们与许多马斯克在政府内部私下交谈过的人聊过。

sentences.en: His theory of government is the way to control government is to control the computers.
sentences.zh: 他对政府的理论是，控制政府的方法就是控制计算机。

sentences.en: So he wants to get access to the computers that house the critical data within the government,
sentences.zh: 所以他希望获得访问政府内部存储关键数据的计算机的权限，

sentences.en: including all the personnel that are on the federal payroll, and also to get access to the pipes that distribute the money.
sentences.zh: 包括联邦工资单上的所有人员，还要获得分发资金的渠道的权限。

sentences.en: And Musk has told administration officials that he thinks they could actually balance the federal budget if they eliminate all the fraudulent payments that are going out to fake
sentences.zh: 马斯克曾向政府官员表示，他认为如果他们消除流向假

sentences.en: people.
sentences.zh: 人的所有欺诈性支付，他们实际上就能平衡联邦预算。

sentences.en: There's no evidence to support that statement that I'm aware of.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，没有任何证据支持这种说法。

sentences.en: But to be fair to Musk, there are billions upon billions of dollars in improper payments that go out.
sentences.zh: 但客观地说，确实有数以百亿计的不当支付流出。

sentences.en: There was a government accountability office estimate that the government made something like $236 billion in improper payments during the 2023 fiscal year.
sentences.zh: 政府问责局曾估计，在2023财年期间，政府进行了大约2360亿美元的不当支付。

sentences.en: Most of those were overpayments.
sentences.zh: 其中大部分是多付款项。

sentences.en: This is to different people around the country, Social Security, what have you.
sentences.zh: 这是给全国各地不同的人的，比如社保等等。

sentences.en: That's a lot of money, to be clear.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，这是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: It's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 这是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: And there is potential for cost savings here.
sentences.zh: 这里确实存在削减成本的潜力。

sentences.en: But I mean, the federal deficit for 2024 was almost $2 trillion.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，2024年的联邦赤字接近2万亿美元。

sentences.en: So Musk is of the view that the government is spending vast amounts of money that is wasteful, that is fraudulent.
sentences.zh: 因此，马斯克认为政府在把巨额资金花在浪费和欺诈上。

sentences.en: And in his sort of platonic ideal, his engineers would just be able to cut off these payments that are going out unilaterally.
sentences.zh: 在他的某种柏拉图式的理想中，他的工程师应该能够单方面切断这些正在流出的支付。

sentences.en: And the question then is, okay, well, what then?
sentences.zh: 那么问题来了，好吧，接下来呢？

sentences.en: Because, you know, this is money appropriated by Congress.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，这是国会拨款的资金。

sentences.en: And it's not actually up to
sentences.zh: 而且实际上并非由

sentences.en: Elon Musk to unilaterally, with his team, direct what payments go out and what payments stay in.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克和他的团队来决定哪些支付该放行、哪些支付该扣留。

sentences.en: It seems, Jonathan, that the fundamental sort of animus and feeling underneath all of these actions
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，在您描述的所有这些行动背后，那种基本的敌意和情感

sentences.en: that you've described, the email, getting inside the pipes of Treasury, is this basic distrust or even disdain of government operations.
sentences.zh: （比如那封邮件、闯入财政部的内部运作），似乎是对政府运作的基本不信任甚至是蔑视。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I don't need to editorialize or speak in my own words on this.
sentences.zh: 而且我不需要对此进行社论评论或用我自己的话来说明这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, you just listen to the people involved in this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你只要听听参与其中的人的说法就知道了。

sentences.en: You know, Russell Vogt, who served in Trump's first administration, and he's his choice again to lead the Office of Management and Budget.
sentences.zh: 你知道，罗素·沃特曾在特朗普第一届政府中任职，他这次再次成为其领导管理和预算局的人选。

sentences.en: He said in a 2023 speech, talking about the plans for their coming back into power, he said, we want the bureaucrats to be traumatically affected.
sentences.zh: 他在2023年的一场演讲中，谈到他们重新掌权的计划时说，我们希望官僚机构受到创伤性的影响。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He said, when they wake up in the morning, we want them not to go into work because they are increasingly viewed as the villains.
sentences.zh: 他说，当他们早上醒来时，我们希望他们不要去上班，因为他们越来越被视为恶人。

sentences.en: He's a very close ally with Elon Musk.
sentences.zh: 他是埃隆·马斯克非常亲密的盟友。

sentences.en: And Musk himself has the same mindset.
sentences.zh: 而马斯克本人也有同样的心态。

sentences.en: I mean, it's very revealing the language he's using.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他使用的语言非常有启发性。

sentences.en: He said, very few in the bureaucracy actually work the weekend.
sentences.zh: 他说，官僚机构中实际上很少有人在周末工作。

sentences.en: So it's like the opposing team just leaves the field for two days.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像对手直接离场两天。

sentences.en: So you see the mindset.
sentences.zh: 所以你看这种心态。

sentences.en: We are coming in and now fully empowered by the President of the
sentences.zh: 我们进来了，现在得到了美国总统的全面授权，带着一种心态：

sentences.en: United States with the attitude of this is a government full of incompetent people, full of people who don't do any work, who are lazy, don't work the weekends.
sentences.zh: 这是一个充满无能之辈的政府，充满了不做任何工作、懒惰、周末不工作的人。

sentences.en: And we are coming in here with the sort of bureaucratic version of a bazooka.
sentences.zh: 我们带着官僚版的火箭筒来到这里。

sentences.en: And he's even talked about eliminating entire agencies.
sentences.zh: 他甚至还谈到要取消整个机构。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是维娜洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的字谜游戏“Connections”，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都创作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有这种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时会看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由刚才你听到的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 从今天开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So Jonathan, you mentioned earlier that Elon Musk set his sights on entire agencies.
sentences.zh: 那么乔纳森，你刚才提到埃隆·马斯克将目标对准了整个机构。

sentences.en: What did you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: What did he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, he has turned his attention very aggressively towards the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他非常激进地将注意力转向了美国国际开发署

sentences.en: Agency for International Development, which is known as USAID.
sentences.zh: ，也就是所谓的USAID。

sentences.en: This is the agency that is charged with delivering humanitarian assistance overseas to some of the most vulnerable people around the world, you know, nutritional assistance
sentences.zh: 这是一个负责向海外世界上一些最脆弱的人群提供人道主义援助的机构，你知道，比如为儿童提供营养援助

sentences.en: for children, designed to help promote stability and humanitarianism.
sentences.zh: ，旨在帮助促进稳定和人道主义。

sentences.en: And we've seen now a pretty stunning series of events.
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到了相当震撼的一系列事件。

sentences.en: A week ago, members of Musk's team entered the headquarters of USAID.
sentences.zh: 一周前，马斯克团队的成员进入了美国国际开发署总部。

sentences.en: They demanded and were granted access to the agency's financial and personnel systeMs.
sentences.zh: 他们要求并获得了访问该机构财务和人事系统的权限。

sentences.en: During that period, an acting administrator at the agency put about 60 senior officials on paid leave and issued stop work orders that led to the firing of hundreds of contractors
sentences.zh: 在此期间，该机构的一位代理署长让大约60名高级官员带薪休假，并发布了停工令，导致数百名拥有全职工作和医疗福利的合同工被解雇。

sentences.en: with full-time employment and health benefits.
sentences.zh: 带全职工作和医疗福利。

sentences.en: By Saturday, the agency's website vanished, like literally just disappeared, went dark.
sentences.zh: 到周六，该机构的网站消失了，字面意思就是直接消失了，变黑了。

sentences.en: And when the top two security directors at USAID tried to stop members of the Musk team
sentences.zh: 当美国国际开发署的两名顶级安全主管试图阻止马斯克团队的成员

sentences.en: from entering a secure area to get classified files, they were placed on administrative leave.
sentences.zh: 进入安全区域获取机密文件时，他们被行政休假了。

sentences.en: Katie Miller, who works on the Musk initiative, said on X that no classified material was accessed without proper security clearances.
sentences.zh: 参与马斯克倡议的凯蒂·米勒在X上表示，没有在没有适当安全许可的情况下访问任何机密材料。

sentences.en: But by Monday, USAID was effectively paralyzed.
sentences.zh: 但到了周一，美国国际开发署实际上已经陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: And Musk has said that the president agreed that we should shut it down.
sentences.zh: 马斯克曾表示，总统同意我们应该将其关闭。

sentences.en: Is Musk just allowed to come in and shut down an entire agency just like that?
sentences.zh: 难道马斯克就可以这样直接进来关掉整个机构吗？

sentences.en: I mean, is Trump fully supportive of this?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特朗普完全支持这一点吗？

sentences.en: Well, remember, it's Congress, not the president, that gets to decide how to structure the executive branch of government.
sentences.zh: 好吧，记住，决定如何构建政府行政部门的是国会，而不是总统。

sentences.en: And Congress has enacted laws that says USAID should exist as an independent establishment.
sentences.zh: 国会已经颁布法律，规定美国国际开发署应作为一个独立机构存在。

sentences.en: So this is running directly into very serious legal questions and questions about whether Congress
sentences.zh: 因此，这直接引发了非常严重的法律问题，以及国会是否会宣示自身权力的问题

sentences.en: is going to assert itself as Trump basically runs roughshod over the institution.
sentences.zh: ，因为特朗普基本上在对这个体制为所欲为。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in terms of Musk's own authority, he's effectively unaccountable because Trump has given him his blessing.
sentences.zh: 至于马斯克自己的权力，他实际上是不受约束的，因为特朗普给了他祝福。

sentences.en: It's not like Trump is really interested in the minutiae of the United States digital service
sentences.zh: 这并不是说特朗普真的对美国数字服务局的琐事感兴趣

sentences.en: or the treasury payment system or all of these pretty wonky and in some cases quite obscure parts of government that Musk and his team are taking control of.
sentences.zh: ，或者是国库支付系统，或者是所有这些相当书呆子气、在某些情况下相当晦涩的政府部门，而马斯克和他的团队正在接管这些部门。

sentences.en: And he keeps Trump, you know, abreaSt.
sentences.zh: 而且他一直让特朗普了解最新情况。

sentences.en: He drops into White House meetings.
sentences.zh: 他会顺道参加白宫会议。

sentences.en: He has an office in the West Wing.
sentences.zh: 他在西翼有一间办公室。

sentences.en: He'll go into the Oval, talk to Trump on the phone.
sentences.zh: 他会走进椭圆形办公室，与特朗普通话。

sentences.en: But even like senior members of the White House staff have found themselves in the dark about what he's doing and trying to figure out after the fact.
sentences.zh: 但即使是白宫的高级幕僚也发现自己对他在做什么一无所知，只能事后去弄清楚。

sentences.en: One Trump official that one of my colleagues talked to who only spoke on the condition of anonymity
sentences.zh: 我的一位同事交谈过的一位特朗普官员在匿名的情况下表示

sentences.en: said that Musk was widely seen as operating with a level of autonomy that almost no one can control.
sentences.zh: ，马斯克被广泛认为以一种几乎没人能控制的自主级别在运作。

sentences.en: In other words, demon mode, as we described earlier.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，正如我们之前所描述的，恶魔模式。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So you now have a situation where you have an entire federal agency that's responsible for
sentences.zh: 所以现在的情况是，你有一个负责在全球提供援助的整个联邦机构

sentences.en: delivering aid around the world where employees there are in a state of confusion, anxiety.
sentences.zh: ，那里的员工处于困惑和焦虑的状态。

sentences.en: They don't know whether their agency will exiSt.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道他们的机构是否还会存在。

sentences.en: Sure doesn't look like it will.
sentences.zh: 看起来确实不会了。

sentences.en: And no one can say this is a surprise.
sentences.zh: 没有人能说这是一个惊喜。

sentences.en: Trump campaigned on this, that we shouldn't be spending money overseas, that we should cut our foreign spending and has been very clear that he intended to do this.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在竞选时就以此为纲领，认为我们不应该把钱花在海外，我们应该削减对外国的开支，并且非常明确地表示他打算这样做。

sentences.en: So while there are really serious legal and constitutional questions about this, nobody who's been
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然这背后存在非常严重的法律和宪法问题，但任何阅读过我们报道并在过去四年里听过唐纳德·特朗普讲话的人

sentences.en: reading our coverage and listening to Donald Trump for the last four years should have any level of surprise that he's doing this.
sentences.zh: 都不会对他在这样做感到一丝一毫的惊讶。

sentences.en: But how much of this is actually about the budget of USAID?
sentences.zh: 但这在多大程度上真的与美国国际开发署的预算有关？

sentences.en: Like, it doesn't strike me as sort of the biggest agency, if you were looking for, you know, big cuts.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你在寻找重大削减的话，它给我的印象似乎并不是最大的机构。

sentences.en: Is this a huge amount of money?
sentences.zh: 这是一笔巨额资金吗？

sentences.en: Is it about something that's beyond the money?
sentences.zh: 这是否关乎超越金钱的东西？

sentences.en: Well, USAID makes up less than 1% of the federal budget.
sentences.zh: 好吧，美国国际开发署占联邦预算不到1%。

sentences.en: You know, it spent about $38 billion in fiscal year 23.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它在23财年花费了大约380亿美元。

sentences.en: Elon Musk has said that their success will be measured on how many dollars per day they slash from federal spending.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克曾表示，他们的成功将以他们每天从联邦开支中削减多少美元来衡量。

sentences.en: So they are looking for dollars everywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以他们到处在找钱。

sentences.en: But there's definitely an ideological component here.
sentences.zh: 但这里肯定有意识形态的成分。

sentences.en: Elon Musk has called USAID evil.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克称美国国际开发署是邪恶的。

sentences.en: That's not just saying, oh, there's $38 billion we want to trim out.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是说，哦，我们想从中削减380亿美元。

sentences.en: No, this is an evil institution in his mind.
sentences.zh: 不，在他心目中这是一个邪恶的机构。

sentences.en: And if you are looking for the platonic ideal of an agency that cuts against the quote-unquote
sentences.zh: 如果你在寻找一个与所谓的“美国优先”议程背道而驰的机构的柏拉图式理想

sentences.en: America first agenda, it's probably the agency that sends money in foreign aid overseas.
sentences.zh: ，那可能就是那个向海外发送外援资金的机构。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The White House sent out a list of things that they say that the USAID is doing that do not align with the president's agenda.
sentences.zh: 白宫发布了一份他们认为美国国际开发署正在做但不符合总统议程的事情的清单。

sentences.en: They picked out, you know, examples that relate to diversity, equity, and inclusion around the world.
sentences.zh: 他们挑出了与世界各地多元化、公平和包容性相关的例子。

sentences.en: And basically, the impression that the White House has sought to create in the public mind is this is a quote-unquote woke agency run by radical lunatics, in Trump's words, that
sentences.zh: 基本上，白宫试图在公众心目中营造的印象是，这是一个用特朗普的话说由激进疯子经营的所谓的觉醒机构

sentences.en: is spreading left-wing gender ideology around the world.
sentences.zh: ，正在向全世界传播左翼性别意识形态。

sentences.en: And we're going to shut it down to save taxpayer money.
sentences.zh: 我们要关掉它来为纳税人省钱。

sentences.en: Where do you think Musk and Doge go from here?
sentences.zh: 你认为马斯克和Doge接下来会去哪里？

sentences.en: Because we're only two weeks into the new administration.
sentences.zh: 因为新政府才上台两周。

sentences.en: So I'm wondering if you expect that he's going to continue to operate without much resistance.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇你是否预计他会继续在没有太大阻力的情况下运作。

sentences.en: So it's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: After Trump won the election, won the popular vote, Democrats have been just a mess, you know,
sentences.zh: 在特朗普赢得大选、赢得普选之后，民主党人简直一团糟，你知道的，

sentences.en: divided, everyone coming up with different theories about why they lost, depressed, some of them capitulating.
sentences.zh: 四分五裂，每个人都对他们为什么失败提出了不同的理论，沮丧，其中一些人甚至投降了。

sentences.en: But we've just seen in the last few days, the resistance starting to awaken.
sentences.zh: 但我们刚刚在过去几天看到，抵抗力量开始觉醒。

sentences.en: And it's actually not Trump who's awakened them.
sentences.zh: 唤醒他们的其实不是特朗普。

sentences.en: It's oddly Elon Musk.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，是埃隆·马斯克。

sentences.en: We're starting to see organized labor rally against him.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到有组织的劳工联合起来对抗他。

sentences.en: You're seeing lawsuits being filed.
sentences.zh: 你看到诉讼正在被提起。

sentences.en: When our constitution is under attack, what are...
sentences.zh: 当我们的宪法受到攻击时，什么是……

sentences.en: You saw protests in D.C.
sentences.zh: 你看到华盛顿特区爆发了抗议活动

sentences.en: outside the buildings of OPM, USAID and the Treasury.
sentences.zh: ，地点在OPM、美国国际开发署和财政部大楼外。

sentences.en: Trump is a puppet of a foreign national whose name is Musk, who has taken over our data, who has taken over our buildings, has locked federal workers out of buildings.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是一个名叫马斯克的外国国民的傀儡，他接管了我们的数据，接管了我们的建筑，把联邦员工锁在大楼外面。

sentences.en: Democratic members of the Senate, who've been pretty quiet since the election, are starting to voice their outrage about what Musk is doing.
sentences.zh: 自大选以来一直相当安静的民主党参议员开始对马斯克的所作所为表示愤怒。

sentences.en: We don't have a fourth branch of government called Elon Musk, and that's going to become real clear.
sentences.zh: 我们没有叫埃隆·马斯克的第四权力分支，这很快就会变得非常清楚。

sentences.en: You're starting to see the resistance, which had been really in hiding since the election, start to emerge again.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到自大选以来一直隐蔽的抵抗力量开始重新浮出水面。

sentences.en: It is embarrassing to read the headlines about free America, where one man is walking around like he is the boss of all of us, and we don't know who put him in charge.
sentences.zh: 看到关于自由美国的头条新闻真是令人尴尬，一个人像我们所有人的老板一样四处走动，而我们不知道是谁让他负责的。

sentences.en: And it is time for us to put an end to that.
sentences.zh: 是时候让我们结束这一切了。

sentences.en: Now, people have been predicting for weeks that Trump and Elon Musk would fall out, that this relationship would not be sustainable.
sentences.zh: 现在，人们已经预测了好几个星期，特朗普和埃隆·马斯克会闹翻，这种关系是不可持续的。

sentences.en: It's actually been much more durable than many people thought.
sentences.zh: 实际上它比许多人想象的要持久得多。

sentences.en: Trump almost entirely speaks very warmly of Musk in private, but he did sound a little bit of a cautionary note on Monday when he was asked about Musk by reporters, and he
sentences.zh: 特朗普私下里几乎完全对马斯克赞不绝口，但在周一被记者问及马斯克时，他确实发出了一些警告的信号，并且

sentences.en: said, quote, Elon can't do and won't do anything without our approval.
sentences.zh: 他说道，引述一下：“如果没有我们的批准，埃隆不能也不会做任何事情。”

sentences.en: And he said, if there's a conflict, then we won't let him near it.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果有冲突，我们就不会让他靠近。

sentences.en: That's fine to say that, but it's not really what's happening in practice.
sentences.zh: 这样说是很好，但现实中发生的并不是这样。

sentences.en: Okay, so Jonathan, is there an argument to be made that this kind of slash and burn tactic
sentences.zh: 好的，那么乔纳森，有没有这样一种观点，即这种大刀阔斧的战术

sentences.en: is actually the only way to carry out the promise that Musk and Trump have made about shrinking the government?
sentences.zh: 实际上是兑现马斯克和特朗普关于缩小政府规模承诺的唯一方法？

sentences.en: And that also, given Musk's track record in the private sector and his unique standing with Trump, Musk is uniquely positioned, some might even say he's really qualified, to make
sentences.zh: 而且，鉴于马斯克在私营部门的记录以及他与特朗普的独特地位，马斯克具有独特的地位，甚至有人可能会说他确实胜任

sentences.en: these kind of cuts in a way that nobody has before?
sentences.zh: 以一种前所未有的方式进行这些削减？

sentences.en: Well, I think there's sort of two separate parts to this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这大致分为两个独立的部分。

sentences.en: One is, is Elon Musk a brilliant entrepreneur who has shown that he is very ruthless about
sentences.zh: 一个是，埃隆·马斯克是否是一位杰出的企业家，他表现出自己在削减成本方面非常冷酷无情

sentences.en: cost cutting to the point where he's taken several of his companies to the brink of destruction before rescuing them?
sentences.zh: ，甚至将他的几家公司推到了毁灭的边缘才拯救它们？

sentences.en: And in the cases of Tesla and SpaceX, turning them into transformational companies?
sentences.zh: 在特斯拉和太空探索技术公司（SpaceX）的例子中，把它们变成变革性的公司？

sentences.en: Yes, yes, all of that is true.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，所有这些都是真的。

sentences.en: Where this becomes thorny is we're not talking about an electric car company where, let's say, Elon Musk didn't manage to pull it back from the brink and it failed.
sentences.zh: 这里变得棘手的地方在于，我们谈论的不是一家电动汽车公司，比方说，如果埃隆·马斯克没能把它从边缘拉回来而它失败了。

sentences.en: Well, the only casualties of that are a slower transition to electric cars, some investors lose their money, some engineers lose their jobs.
sentences.zh: 那么，这带来的唯一代价是向电动汽车过渡的速度变慢了，一些投资者亏了钱，一些工程师失去了工作。

sentences.en: Not to diminish that, but now you're talking about the federal government writ large.
sentences.zh: 这并不是要贬低这一点，但现在你谈论的是整个联邦政府。

sentences.en: So is there the possibility that Elon Musk and Trump could slash huge amounts of money out of the federal government?
sentences.zh: 那么埃隆·马斯克和特朗普从联邦政府中削减巨额资金的可能性是否存在？

sentences.en: Yes, of course there is.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然存在。

sentences.en: But the stakes feel really different here.
sentences.zh: 但这里的利害关系感觉真的很不一样。

sentences.en: The stakes are different, right?
sentences.zh: 利害关系不同，对吧？

sentences.en: You're talking about the country and the federal government and you're talking about the public intereSt.
sentences.zh: 你谈论的是国家和联邦政府，你谈论的是公众利益。

sentences.en: And just take one example, right?
sentences.zh: 就拿一个例子来说，对吧？

sentences.en: Elon Musk leads this effort to send out this email to the entire federal workforce.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克领导了这一努力，向整个联邦劳动力发送了这封电子邮件。

sentences.en: Email saying, basically, we'd love if you would just resign.
sentences.zh: 基本上是发邮件说，如果你能直接辞职，我们会很高兴。

sentences.en: Just think about that for a second.
sentences.zh: 仔细想想。

sentences.en: Who are the federal employees that are most likely to take that offer?
sentences.zh: 最有可能接受这个提议的联邦雇员是谁？

sentences.en: It's probably people who have options outside, who are sought after, who have technical expertise that is valuable, that private sector companies could benefit from.
sentences.zh: 可能是那些在外面有选择、抢手、拥有有价值的技术专长、私营部门公司可以受益的人。

sentences.en: So you're going to potentially lose, actually, the thin layer at the top that is most skilled, most experienced, and potentially most critical to the functionings of government.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会失去实际上处于顶层、最有技能、最有经验、可能对政府职能最至关重要的薄薄一层人。

sentences.en: So basically what you're saying is that you're encouraging possibly the most talented, maybe
sentences.zh: 所以你基本上是在说，你可能在鼓励最优秀的人才，也许

sentences.en: some of the most important civil servants across the government who do a range of things to leave.
sentences.zh: 还有政府中从事各种工作的最重要的公务员离开。

sentences.en: And that does raise a really interesting question of who is left.
sentences.zh: 这就提出了一个非常有趣的问题，即还剩下谁。

sentences.en: Yes, and the other thing that is challenging with this reporting on Elon Musk is that in this role, it's actually very hard sometimes to discern where the public interest ends and
sentences.zh: 是的，关于埃隆·马斯克的报道中另一个具有挑战性的事情是，在这个角色中，有时真的很难辨别公共利益在哪里结束，

sentences.en: where Elon Musk's private interests begin.
sentences.zh: 而埃隆·马斯克的私人利益又从哪里开始。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about his private interests, actually, because there's a whole other dimension
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈他的私人利益，因为

sentences.en: to this that we haven't even talked about, which is how much business Elon Musk does with the federal government.
sentences.zh: 这还有一个我们甚至还没有谈到的维度，那就是埃隆·马斯克与联邦政府有多少业务往来。

sentences.en: Even if you think he's the right person to cut it down, and even if you think his experience
sentences.zh: 即使你认为他是将其精简的合适人选，即使你认为他在

sentences.en: at Twitter is relevant here, and just to remind people, when he took over Twitter and gutted it and got rid of a lot of employees, people said Twitter will never survive this.
sentences.zh: 推特的经验在这里是相关的，提醒一下大家，当他接管推特并将其掏空并摆脱了大量员工时，人们说推特永远无法在这次打击中存活下来。

sentences.en: And obviously, Twitter X is very much still operational.
sentences.zh: 很明显，Twitter X 仍在很大程度上运营。

sentences.en: Even if you think all of that experience is relevant, he still has all kinds of potential conflicts of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 即使你认为所有这些经验都是相关的，他仍然拥有各种潜在的利益冲突。

sentences.en: So tell us a little bit about that.
sentences.zh: 所以给我们讲讲这方面的情况吧。

sentences.en: Well, you have the richest man in the world whose companies have billions of dollars worth of contracts with the federal government.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你拥有世界上最富有的人，他的公司与联邦政府拥有价值数十亿美元的合同。

sentences.en: I mean, SpaceX, his rocket company, you know, effectively dictates NASA's launch schedule.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他的火箭公司 SpaceX，你知道的，实际上主导了 NASA 的发射时间表。

sentences.en: And you have the president of the United States giving Musk vast power over the bureaucracy that regulates his companies and awards them contracts.
sentences.zh: 而美国总统赋予了马斯克巨大的权力，让他去掌控那个监管他公司并向其授标合同的官僚机构。

sentences.en: The intermingling is extremely tight.
sentences.zh: 这种利益交融极其紧密。

sentences.en: He's shaping not just policy, but personnel decisions.
sentences.zh: 他在塑造的不仅仅是政策，还有人事决策。

sentences.en: Officially, Musk is serving as a special government employee, according to the White House.
sentences.zh: 据白宫称，官方上马斯克担任的是特殊政府雇员。

sentences.en: But this is a status typically given to part-time outside advisors to the federal government who offer their advice based on their private sector expertise.
sentences.zh: 但这种身份通常是给联邦政府的非全职外部顾问的，他们根据其私营部门的专业知识提供建议。

sentences.en: And so he has not had to divest from any of his businesses.
sentences.zh: 因此，他根本不需要从他的任何商业企业中剥离股份。

sentences.en: He still retains his interest in all his businesses.
sentences.zh: 他仍然保留着他在所有企业中的权益。

sentences.en: And he is hardly a part-time advisor offering advice.
sentences.zh: 而且他绝不是一个提供建议的兼职顾问。

sentences.en: And that's before we even get to his foreign conflicts.
sentences.zh: 这甚至还没算上他在海外的利益冲突。

sentences.en: Tesla has relied to a significant extent on the Chinese government and the Chinese market.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉在很大程度上依赖于中国政府和中国市场。

sentences.en: So there are just conflicts as far as the eye can see.
sentences.zh: 所以，只要放眼望去，到处都是利益冲突。

sentences.en: And while Trump has asserted that where there's a conflict of interest, they won't allow Musk to play in that area, the bare facts already disprove that.
sentences.zh: 尽管特朗普坚称，哪里有利益冲突，他们就不会允许马斯克插手那个领域，但赤裸裸的事实已经对此进行了反驳。

sentences.en: Jonathan, you have covered Trump and those around him for years, obviously.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，显然你多年来一直在报道特朗普和他的核心圈子。

sentences.en: And their biggest complaint, and you hear this almost every day from people like Stephen
sentences.zh: 他们最大的抱怨——你几乎每天都能从像斯蒂芬

sentences.en: Miller, one of the president's top advisors you profiled on the show last week, is that the federal government has become overrun by unelected bureaucrats who are accountable
sentences.zh: 米勒这样的人那里听到，他是总统的顶级顾问之一，上周你在节目中做过他的专题报道——是联邦政府已经被那些不对任何人负责、

sentences.en: to nobody.
sentences.zh: 未经选举产生的官僚们所把持。

sentences.en: They don't face elections.
sentences.zh: 他们不用面临选举。

sentences.en: And in fact, even a few days ago, Elon Musk himself said it was time to, quote, restore power to the people from the vast unelected bureaucracy.
sentences.zh: 事实上，就在几天前，埃隆·马斯克本人还说，是时候用他的话说，“从庞大且未经选举产生的官僚机构手中将权力夺回给人民”了。

sentences.en: But given everything you've laid out here for us, it feels like Musk and Doge have become arguably the most powerful unelected bureaucracy possibly in the history of the country.
sentences.zh: 但鉴于你在这里为我们梳理的一切，感觉马斯克和政府效率部（Doge）已经成为了该国历史上可以说是权力最大的、未经选举产生的官僚机构。

sentences.en: So what they used to exist in this country was the spoil system.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个国家过去曾存在的是政党分赃制。

sentences.en: It was a patronage system where when power changed hands, government was stocked with supporters,
sentences.zh: 这是一种恩庇体制，当政权更迭时，政府里就会塞满支持者，

sentences.en: people were rewarded with jobs, a series of laws were passed that made the civil service
sentences.zh: 人们因工作而受到奖赏，随后通过了一系列法律，使公务员队伍

sentences.en: permanent effectively or gave them really strong job protections, with the idea being that people develop expertise over a long period of time.
sentences.zh: 实际上成为常态，或者赋予他们极强的职业保障，其理念是人们在长期内能够积累专业知识。

sentences.en: These are not inherently political jobs or shouldn't be.
sentences.zh: 这些本质上不是、也不应该是具有政治色彩的工作。

sentences.en: And what we're potentially seeing right now is the return to that spoil system, to eliminating
sentences.zh: 而我们现在可能正在看到的，是向那种分赃制的倒退，是消除

sentences.en: this permanent bureaucracy and replacing it each time a new president comes in with their
sentences.zh: 这种常态化的官僚体制，并在每当新总统上台时用他们自己的人取而代之，

sentences.en: cohort, not just for a thin layer at the top, as happens every administration, but for something for a much larger group of people.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是像每届政府发生的那样替换高层的一小薄层，而是替换更大的一群人。

sentences.en: And when you have the richest man in the world leading this effort, still holding his interests
sentences.zh: 当拥有世界上最富有的人来领导这项工作，他仍然持有其私营公司的股份，

sentences.en: in his private companies, still his companies doing billions of dollars of business with the federal
sentences.zh: 他的公司仍然在与联邦政府进行价值数十亿美元的业务往来，

sentences.en: government, still with his companies being regulated by the federal government, you have a level of conflict of interest that we've just never seen in the modern era.
sentences.zh: 他的公司依然受到联邦政府的监管，这就达到了我们在现代历史上从未见过的利益冲突程度。

sentences.en: Jonathan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, Elon Musk and his team took aim at their latest federal agency, the Department of Education.
sentences.zh: 周二，埃隆·马斯克和他的团队将矛头对准了他们最新的联邦机构——教育部。

sentences.en: Officials told employees that Doge was scrutinizing their operations, and they warned that it could lead to staff reductions.
sentences.zh: 官员们告诉员工，政府效率部（Doge）正在审查他们的业务，并警告这可能导致裁员。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Today I'm delighted to welcome Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu back to the White House.
sentences.zh: 今天，我很高兴欢迎以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡重返白宫。

sentences.en: In a joint news conference on Tuesday night at the White House, President Trump said the United
sentences.zh: 在周二晚于白宫举行的一场联合新闻发布会上，特朗普总统表示，美国

sentences.en: States would take over Gaza, permanently relocate two million of its Palestinian residents, and turn the enclave into, quote, the Riviera of the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 将接管加沙，永久重新安置其两百万巴勒斯坦居民，并将这块飞地变成用他的话说，“中东的里维埃拉”。

sentences.en: This was not a decision made lightly.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个轻易做出的决定。

sentences.en: Everybody I've spoken to loves the idea of the United States owning that piece of land, developing and creating thousands of jobs with something that will be magnificent.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的每个人都喜欢美国拥有那片土地的想法，去开发并创造数千个就业岗位，打造出宏伟壮丽的事物。

sentences.en: Trump said that developing Gaza would supply jobs and housing for, quote,
sentences.zh: 特朗普表示，开发加沙将为……提供就业和住房

sentences.en: The statement was also striking because it contradicted decades of U.S.
sentences.zh: 这一声明之所以令人震惊，是因为它违背了数十年来美国

sentences.en: policy that has favored a two-state solution.
sentences.zh: 一直倾向于“两国方案”的政策。

sentences.en: But just like statements the president has made about taking over Greenland and the Panama Canal,
sentences.zh: 但就像总统之前关于接管格陵兰岛和巴拿马运河的言论一样，

sentences.en: Trump did not cite any legal authority that would allow him to take Gaza over, nor did he address the fact that forcible removal of an entire population violates international law.
sentences.zh: 特朗普没有引用任何能允许他接管加沙的法律依据，也没有解决强行驱逐整个族群违反国际法这一事实。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday, China responded to the 10 percent tariff imposed by Trump with a flurry of
sentences.zh: 而在周二，中国对特朗普施加的百分之十的关税做出了回应，推出了一系列

sentences.en: retaliatory measures, including tariffs of its own on liquefied natural gas, coal, and farm machinery imported from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 报复性措施，包括对从美国进口的液化天然气、煤炭和农业机械征收关税。

sentences.en: The back and forth demonstrated how quickly Trump's tariffs can escalate into a series of painful tit-for-tat economic reprisals.
sentences.zh: 这种来回交锋表明，特朗普的关税政策能以多快的速度升级为一系列痛苦的针锋相对的经济报复。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场痛苦、混乱有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。
